page_note: This page contains NO cosmological substrate. It is a first-person Mani-discourse enumerating "matters" (third, fourth, fifth) about his apostolic mission: distant lands blessing his name, magnates/kings opposing him, freeing his sons/brothers/kinsmen, clothing them in the garment of Wisdom, establishing his Church, sowing Truth through apostles and ambassadors, contrasting himself with previous apostles (except Jesus). This is institutional foundation narrative — Mani's testament about his church and mission. The teaching-purity score of 0.000 confirms zero substrate vocabulary. The strong second-half fatigue drift (apostolic_dialogue 0→10.3, ecclesial 2.8→6.9) reflects the explicit shift to apostles/Church/Sabaoth/psalms-of-Wisdom in the latter half. Classify uniformly as manichaean_ecclesial.

'Acted beforehand against me, together with the magnates' — political opponents in editorial present.
Mani complaining about earthly powers cutting him from Truth — biographical/persecution narrative.
'They had no power against me' — first-person apostolic vindication.
Continuation of persecution complaint.
Closes the second-matter unit.
'The third matter' — enumeration of Mani's institutional acts, not cosmological enumeration.
'Has given freedom to his sons' — comparison to a worldly liberator setting up Mani's parallel act.
Brothers, kinsmen, freemen — community-formation vocabulary. High ecclesial score (50.0).
'Variety of all the works — just so I...' — analogy frame, not cosmic mapping.
'All my sons free from every toil' — Mani liberating his community.
Closes third-matter unit.
'The fourth matter' — Mani enumerating institutional acts.
'Garment of Wisdom' — initiatic clothing, ecclesial-ritual register.
Companion analogy.

Extending the companion claim to Mani's sons.
'[Fifth] matter: I have chosen, in my power, the entire great chosen-ness' — election of the Elect, core ecclesial language.
'Sons... Sabaoth' — institutional bestowal.
'Great psalms of Wisdom' — Manichaean liturgical corpus reference.
'The apostles give... of the Church' — explicit ecclesial institution. Highest combined ecclesial+dialogue score.
'I established my Church; I placed within her' — direct ecclesial founding speech.
Continuation of Church-establishment statement.
'I have sown the Truth in all the lands' — universal-mission rhetoric.
'Through apostles and through ambassadors' — Manichaean mission terminology.
Sending of apostles to all lands — institutional mission narrative.
Comparison: previous apostles 'did not do according to what I [did]' — Mani's superiority claim.
'Except Jesus alone, the Son of [Greatness]' — Christological-apostolic frame, citation register.
'Father of all the apostles' — apostolic genealogy, editorial.
'All the apostles did not do as I have done' — Mani's claim to surpass prior apostles.

'My multitude — for not one of the first apostles...' — comparison continues.
'In the flesh at all in my likeness' — incarnational-apostolic claim, heavily damaged.
